title: Two-factor prompt returns on every login in Safari

articles.subject: Two-factor prompt returns on every login in Safari
articles.body:
Hi,

I tick "remember this device" but the code is requested again the next morning. My colleague on Chrome is not asked for weeks. I am on a Mac with Safari, nothing unusual in the settings as far as I can tell.

/Nina

articles.subject: Re: Two-factor prompt returns on every login in Safari
articles.body:
Hi Nina,

The device is remembered with a cookie that we set for 30 days. Safari's tracking prevention caps cookies set in certain ways at seven days, and ours was set from a script rather than by the server, which puts it in that category.

We are moving it to a server-set cookie in the next release. After that Safari will keep it the full 30 days.

Regards,
Jonas

articles.subject: Re: Two-factor prompt returns on every login in Safari
articles.body: Released version behaves. Not asked for a code since Monday. Thanks.
